statements.t: Our historical results are not necessarily indicative of the results that may be expected for any period in the future.
As such, we believe that the cash flows generated from operating activities will meet our anticipated cash requirements in the short-term.

In addition to normal working capital requirements, we anticipate that our short- and long-term cash requirements will include share repurchases, introduction of new products and offerings, development of our platform, debt repayments, expansion of sales and marketing activities, and charitable contributions, including to Airbnb.org.
On a long-term basis, we plan to rely on either our access to the capital markets or our credit facility for any long-term funding not provided by operating cash flows and cash on hand.
As our AI assistant becomes capable of resolving more types of issues, we expect to provide even better support at lower costs.
Building a new kind of AI agent We don’t believe people will use one AI agent for everything.

We believe the best agents will be specialized, built by companies that deeply understand the people they serve, have earned their trust, and can help them take action—not just answer questions in a chatbot.

Because Airbnb handles reservations, payments, and customer support, our agent will be able to help guests throughout their trip—from changing a reservation or resolving a payment issue to getting help with refunds, rebooking, or 24-hour safety support.

We plan to start rolling it out to guests in the first half of 2027. 3 Skift and McKinsey’s seventh annual research collaboration, based on a study of 1,000 consumers and traveler diaries, as cited in Skift, “How Travel Search, Discovery and Booking Are Being Rewritten”.

statements.t: Our supply acquisition strategy is disciplined and targeted, prioritizing the right homes, in the right place, at the right time.
Together with efforts to drive demand, this targeted supply approach is helping drive a higher fill rate, and ultimately more nights and earnings to our hosts.
Adjusted EBITDA Margin in Q3 2026 was 52%, compared to 50% in Q3 2025.5 For the full-year 2026, we expect our effective tax rate to be in the mid-teens.
